items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Frankie Russell, Joe Thomas. [INTERVIEWEE] What's the little Pete Herman, the one that went blind? Yeah. They always have a lot of fights.

ctx.x: He died with owning a lot of New York property up south. He did well.

He put his money in good juice up there. Yeah, they had... Then they had Harry Wills, the human scissors, boxcar shorty, rough house wares. Joe Mandot used to fight Johnny Dundee. Yeah, we saw a Mandot fight over here. Frankie Russell, Joe Thomas.
What's the little Pete Herman, the one that went blind? Yeah. They always have a lot of fights.
